sections.name: Phone apps
sections.intro: Native iPhone or Android apps that pair with the Pi on your computer.

sections.name: Phone-first web apps
sections.intro: Open a page on your phone; a small server or extension next to Pi serves it.

sections.name: Notifications
sections.intro: Get told when Pi finishes or needs you, and answer from the lock screen or a push service.

sections.name: Multi-agent apps with Pi support
sections.intro: Clients for several coding agents that also drive Pi.

sections.name: Do it yourself
sections.intro: No extra app: reach the terminal Pi runs in.

projects.name: Hey Atu
projects.platforms: iPhone, iPad (coming soon); Mac app, Terminal
projects.reach: Outbound connection to an end-to-end encrypted relay; no port or VPN
projects.what: Continues a terminal Pi session on the phone, with Todo, Updates, Days and Wiki around it. Uses the Pi you already have.

projects.name: Remote Pi
projects.reach: QR pairing over a relay; the community relay can read messages, or self-host it
projects.what: Chat with your local Pi and watch tool calls; also a local agent mesh.

projects.name: Pi Mobile (Android)
projects.what: Browse, resume and steer sessions over Pi's RPC mode.

projects.name: Pi Remote iOS
projects.what: Controls the active terminal session; early preview.

projects.name: Pi Remote (Compose)
projects.what: Sessions grouped by project, live view and chat from the couch.

projects.name: π Remote
projects.reach: WebSocket daemon on your network; not for the open internet
projects.what: Monitor and steer a Pi TUI or RPC session.

projects.name: Pi Companion
projects.what: Projects, sessions and full history, using Pi's documented session files and RPC mode.

projects.name: Pi in Pocket
projects.reach: Open-source bridge server on your computer
projects.what: Monitor and control Pi; no analytics.

projects.name: Pi Dev Mobile
projects.reach: Server URL and token for `npx pi-rpc-server` on your computer
projects.what: Chat with Pi from the phone and pick the model and thinking level per message.

projects.name: Pi Relay
projects.reach: QR pairing with your own Pi remote
projects.what: Browse sessions, navigate trees, fork or clone conversations.

projects.name: Pi Remote - PiR
projects.what: Chat, watch Pi work, review the diff and commit.

projects.name: pi.dev remote (Clever Cloud)
projects.what: Send prompts, approve tool calls, answer questions, stop a run.

projects.name: Pi Pocket
projects.what: Durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi; runs keep going after a restart.

projects.name: pi-agent-dashboard
projects.what: Multi-session dashboard with live chat mirroring and a terminal; its mobile layout (swipe drawer, large touch targets) works over mDNS or a zrok tunnel.

projects.name: Pi-Remote (browser)
projects.reach: Pi extension serving a web page
projects.what: Mirrors a live terminal session to the browser; send messages and commands back.

projects.name: pi-phone
projects.what: Mirrors the active session and can start parallel sessions.

projects.name: pi-mobile (web)
projects.what: Start, monitor and resume sessions.

projects.name: pi-anywhere
projects.what: A chat UI for the same Pi instance; no tmux or terminal emulator.

projects.name: pi-knock
projects.what: Notifies when a task finishes or needs input.

projects.name: Pi Pulse
projects.reach: Bridge package and a menu bar companion
projects.what: Approve, reject or reply to a session from the phone.

projects.name: Sesori
projects.what: One phone app for several coding agents, Pi among them: get notified when one needs you and answer from the phone.

projects.name: Paseo
projects.reach: End-to-end encrypted relay, or your own machine
projects.what: Runs Pi, Claude Code, Codex and more in parallel; has a page for Pi.

projects.name: Muxflow
projects.what: Notifications when Pi needs input, voice replies, files and Git.

projects.name: pi pod
projects.what: Runs Pi sessions in remote sandboxes you host, with native phone apps to start and follow them.

projects.name: SSH + mosh + tmux
projects.reach: A private network such as Tailscale
projects.what: Keep Pi in tmux and attach from the phone; mosh survives sleep and network changes.

projects.name: Pi in Termux
projects.what: Run Pi on the phone without another machine.
